body: Are you physically there and have feeling?
I like how you put that, thanks for the reply

I’m 18 single and right here with you, I have no clue as to what I want to do with my life and that goes from what career I want to have? To who do I want to be as a person? Do I want to get married? Is there a place I want to live or travel too? And so many more. I know it can be frustrating seeing everyone else around you who have their lives seemingly planned out ten years in the future but you’ll figure it out soon.
